request.query: Roth polynomial index negation sign Taylor expansion weighted index invariant

items.name: HasFiniteFPowerSeriesAt.neg
items.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [inst : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {f : E → F}
  {pf : FormalMultilinearSeries 𝕜 E F} {x : E} {n : ℕ},
  HasFiniteFPowerSeriesAt f pf x n → HasFiniteFPowerSeriesAt (-f) (-pf) x n

items.name: Polynomial.ofFinsupp_neg
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] {a : AddMonoidAlgebra R ℕ}, { toFinsupp := -a } = -{ toFinsupp := a }

items.name: Polynomial.roots_neg
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] (p : Polynomial R), (-p).roots = p.roots

items.name: Polynomial.toFinsupp_neg
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] (a : Polynomial R), (-a).toFinsupp = -a.toFinsupp

items.name: Poly.neg_apply
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (f : Poly α) (x : α → ℕ), (-f) x = -f x

items.name: Polynomial.reflect_neg
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Ring R] (f : Polynomial R) (N : ℕ), Polynomial.reflect N (-f) = -Polynomial.reflect N f
